messages:
maya: Heads up — planning to roll out the new filter bar sampling + per-route quota visibility to the console beta tomorrow 9am PT. Need final sign-off on telemetry keys and the fallback behavior.

zane: Quick question — is the sampling applied client-side (console) or at the API gateway?

kim: It's on the API side, near the routing layer. We'll tag events with sample_rate and sampled=true/false. client hints will also include user-level override if present.

zane: OK. Will the sample be per-route or global? We want accurate cost estimates for heavy routes.

jonathan: We should do per-route by default and allow a global override. Implementation plan: sampling decisions at request ingress with stable hashing on route_id + day to keep correlations low.

elena: Telemetry needs: route_id, filter_preset_id (if any), sampling_rate, sampled, quota_bucket, and ui_variant (new-filterbar / legacy). Also a trace_id for joining logs.

maya: Agreed. Also add a boolean for "quota_notice_shown" so we can measure if the visibility influences user behavior.

kim: API payload sketch: 
```
POST /v1/console/event
{
  "route_id": "r_123",
  "event":"filter_applied",
  "meta":{
    "filter_preset_id":"fp_4",
    "sampling_rate":"0.05",
    "sampled":true,
    "quota_bucket":"dedicated-monthly",
    "ui_variant":"new-filterbar",
    "quota_notice_shown":false,
    "trace_id":"t_abc123"
  }
}
```

zane: UI question: where does the quota notice live? Inline pill next to route name, or in the filterbar status area?

maya: Proposal: compact pill near the route name with a tooltip showing tokens remaining and a link to quota management. For power users show expanded panel in the filterbar when clicked.

elena: For analytics, we want the pill clicks instrumented (`quota_pill_clicked`) and the expanded panel open events. Also capture token consumed per filter application when sampled.

jonathan: Rollout strategy: 10% of orgs for 24h, expand to 50% for 48h, then 100% if no regressions. Auto-fallback: if median filter apply latency > 120ms or error rate +1% vs baseline, switch those orgs back to legacy.

kim: Backend will publish a per-org flag for rollout and a threshold monitor. We'll expose a `console_filterbar_mode` config in org settings.

zane: UX edgecases — saved queries: when a user loads a saved query that relies on model-level filters, the sampling must still happen and the UI should surface if the saved query was recorded under a different sampling rate. Suggest a small badge: "saved under 5% sampling".

maya: Good catch. Add `saved_query_sampling_rate` to saved-query metadata and show badge if different from current.

elena: For dashboards/alerts: create a datadog dashboard with panels: filtered_events_sampled_rate by route, quota_pill_clicks, median_filter_apply_latency (new vs legacy), savedquery_mismatch_rate. I'll share the dashboard JSON after this thread.

jonathan: To reduce noise, please ensure sampling_rate is normalized to a decimal (e.g., 0.05) and included in metric tags so aggregation is straightforward.

kim: One more internal API debate — do we surface `sampled=true` events in raw telemetry stream or only sampled ones? We should emit both: sampled events with full payload, non-sampled with minimal envelope. That keeps traces consistent.

maya: That works. Make sure privacy and cost docs reflect storage increase.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled — console-filterbar-sampling v1 -> staging @ 2026-03-20T16:00:00Z :rocket:

elena: Small ask — add a synthetic test that applies filters to a heavy route every 5m during rollout so we catch perf regressions quickly.

kim: Will add a k8s cronjob with a lightweight harness.

zane: UX follow-up: can we show an adaptive hint in the filterbar when sampling is high (>=20%) that explains why results might vary? Text example: "Results are partially sampled to reduce cost — some metrics are approximate."

maya: Yes. Copy: "Partial sampling active for this route — metrics shown are estimated. Click to see sampling rate and quota details."

jonathan: Final checklist before 9am PT: telemetry keys added (kim/elena), rollout flag in platform (kim/jonathan), UI pill + badge (zane), dashboard + synth tests (elena), docs + privacy update (maya). Everyone OK?

zane: OK from front-end.

kim: Backend ✅.

elena: Analytics ✅.

maya: I'll update the rollout doc and send the beta invite. Thanks all :thumbsup:
